Targets reportedly include non-governmental, media, humanitarian and development entities interested in Yemen, including people attending Saudi Arabian government-led negotiations. The group reportedly uses spoofed Android apps, encrypted messengers and link shorteners, and the report names the SpyNote, SpyMax and njRAT remote access tools. 6bc8f6928136857afc21813e6ed5c27427f3d106.summary: Genians Security Center describes Operation ToyBox Story, a March 2025 spear phishing campaign attributed to the APT37 group, linked to North Korea, targeting activists focused on North Korea. Lures impersonated a South Korean national security think tank event, and malicious LNK files in ZIP archives delivered the RoKRAT malware. RoKRAT used cloud services including Dropbox, pCloud and Yandex as command-and-control. The report links some accounts to Russian Yandex services, hedges some findings, and says the investigation is ongoing.
